image_description: Two soap bubbles floating in mid-air against a blurred dark green background. The larger bubble on the right shows strong iridescent rainbow colors (purple, blue, green) and reflects a distorted view of the surroundings. The smaller bubble on the left is clearer but also exhibits thin-film interference colors (cyan, magenta) and reflects the environment. Both appear spherical with glossy surfaces.
